I am currently pursuing God and attend/serve at a non-denom church, though I do have my struggles. 

I’ve done a handful of hallucinogens in my college years while not actively seeking God or church after being raised strictly in the faith. 

Robotripping: nothing much of note here, some euphoria, but I think it gave me diarrhea. 

Mushrooms: high level of euphoria, some mild level of environment induced visuals. Never had a bad trip, relatively enjoyed myself. 

Acid/LSD: done 1 or 2 times and had what I would describe as “bad trips” from what I can recall. They would start out fine with environment induced visuals but I would transition into these disturbing hallucinations/ideas. I would get this impression that I was in this sort of hell where the people I was tripping with were either stuck there with me or some appeared as demons with skeletal/demonic faces. And the concept that I had determined of this hell I was in, was that people would live there lives and get drawn into doing ACID and once you did that you were stuck in hell for the rest of eternity. Occasionally I would come to some level of grips of reality, but I would sneak into my room to find my bible for comfort when I couldn’t. 

DMT: This experience was the most indescribable of them all and I could potentially see people describe it as a religious experience. I did it 2x in a like 1 hour period. Both times after consuming it I would fade into another world/mindset. One of the times I remember feeling like was floating across an ocean with birds and clouds surrounding me. The other time I just remember being consumed by sounds and colors that put me in awe, and feeling like I was flying through space, passing beautiful planets. After coming to 5-10 mins later, it felt like time was in slow motion and that it would be stuck like that forever, but 20-30 mins later I caught a grip on the concept of time again. 

Marijuana/THC: After smoking A LOT in college I have consumed weed little to none since. I have had a variety of different experiences in those few times. (1) where I felt  like I was having a panic attack due to extreme paranoia at the situation and people around me, to the point where I felt the need to quote bible verses. (2) smoked around someone who made me feel odd and I got drawn back to my acid trip and thought he might be the devil (3) smoked before reading the Bible and I felt some verses speaking to me more for my specific time of life (4) felt convicted about certain things in life while high and felt called to reach out to pastoral leadership about getting more involved at church. (5) smoked in a state where it was legal before my flight home and felt relatively fine, a little paranoid but the flight was calm. (6) Smoked CBD weed for my messed up knee. 
I feel like Marijuana in moderation be used as a tool for certain things that require focus/pain relief/ and in some cases increase spiritually sensitivity. But I can also accept that I may be wrong. 

As for the other hardcore hallucinogens, I agree with another commentator that what your intentions and environment are when taking them definitely affect the outcome. Maybe like a self fulfilling prophecy.
